items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Each W4 acceptance criterion maps to code and a test: off by default, test mail with exact failure, one mail per (kind,id,day), triage once ever, persistence across restart, secret only in .env.local and never in logs/answers, escaped mail without paths, Settings card per page 04 and the Inbox failed-send notice per page 06.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Send failures are scrubbed, counted (max 3 per item and day), shown in Settings and the Inbox; a damaged or locked ledger fails closed with a visible reason; a check that cannot read a project says so instead of reporting nothing due.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Password write-only (set / not set only), refused inside a git repo, scrubbed in all spellings from errors, not carried to a changed SMTP host; JSON content type + cross-site refusal + test-mail rate limit; mail text escaped, paths redacted, http(s) links only, subject cannot inject headers.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Unit tests for compose/service/ledger/settings/timer/routes, a loopback fake-SMTP integration test with the real nodemailer, jsdom card tests, and a real-browser spec that sends a test mail through the real server; leak tests use a random password per run.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Timer ticks once a minute and reads one small file; mail off means no tool call; at most 25 mails per check and a stop after 2 consecutive failures; due reads are sequential per project.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All new files under 300 lines in core/reminder-mail/; index.ts keeps its 958-line baseline (the W1 route mount and the mail wiring share one line); no baseline file edited.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (service) to consumer (SMTP server) probed with the real nodemailer against a loopback server and in a real browser; ledger and settings files round-trip including a damaged-file case; .env.local round-trip with quote and backslash characters.
